name: abuse_review_case
comment: One row per account per AbuseReview queue, shown as one row in that queue.

columns.name: arc_actor
columns.comment: The account the case is about. Key to actor.actor_id.

columns.name: arc_tag_id
columns.comment: The change tag of the queue. Key to change_tag_def.ctd_id.

columns.name: arc_updated_timestamp
columns.comment: When the case last changed: a new flag, a decision, or a reopen. The list sorts on it.

columns.name: arc_handled_by_actor
columns.comment: The admin who marked the case as handled. Key to actor.actor_id. 0 while the case is open.

name: abuse_review_case_property
comment: One integer property per AbuseReview case, such as the flag count.

columns.name: arcp_name
columns.comment: Name of the property, such as flag_count.
